featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointed with my experience at Aarthi Scans and Labs.

I visited on Sunday for multiple tests including blood tests and an MRI Orbit. Before the scan, I submitted my doctor’s prescription, which clearly mentioned “MRI Orbit with placement of muscle for limbus.” Your staff reviewed the prescription, discussed it internally, and confirmed that the required scan could be done. Based on that assurance, I proceeded and paid for the test.

When I visited my doctor with the reports, I was informed that the most important detail — proper muscle placement from the limbus — was not included in the report.

I immediately contacted Aarthi Scans and was told the missing details would be provided by the next evening. After waiting again, your team finally called and said that MRI Orbit cannot show these muscle placement details at all.

My question is simple: If you already knew MRI Orbit could not provide what was clearly written in the prescription, why did you accept the scan in the first place?

I am a patient, not a doctor or medical professional. I cannot be expected to know which scan can or cannot show specific findings. That is exactly why I rely on trained medical staff and diagnostic centers.

Because of this mistake, I have faced:
• Unnecessary expense
• Waste of time
• Mental stress
• Delay in my eye surgery

My doctor is available only once every 15–20 days, so this error may now delay my surgery by weeks or even a month. This concerns my eyes and surgery, which should never be taken lightly.

Very poor communication and lack of responsibility. I expected much better professionalism.

featured_reviews.name: Nitin Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience at Neptune Diagnostic and Fetal Medicine.
When I visited for a sonography at around 11:00 AM, the staff initially informed me that the total cost would be ₹5000. After that, I confirmed with my doctor and went back for the sonography after about half an hour. At that time, the staff suddenly told me that the total cost would be ₹6500. Later they said they had spoken with the accounts department and confirmed that I only needed to pay ₹5000, so I made the payment.
However, when I went the next day to collect my report, they again told me that the total amount was ₹6000 and asked me to pay an additional ₹1000. This information was given by a marketing staff member named Mukund. The details regarding the sonography and payment were earlier explained to me by staff member Vrunali and their account manager.
Apart from the billing confusion, the waiting time was extremely long and poorly managed. I went there at 11:00 AM, but at 3:30 PM they told me to come back in the evening at 6:30 PM. After returning in the evening, I was again made to wait for around 2 more hours. There seemed to be no respect for patients’ time.
For such a large organization, the time management and coordination are very poor. There was no senior person available, and the staff seemed to be working only based on guidance from each other, which created confusion.
Overall, I had a very bad service experience. *The doctor is very good and very cooperative* but the management and service system are very poor. Because of this experience, I will never visit this place again and will not recommend it to anyone.

I have the recording of the conversation about the charges and staff communication. If needed, I can provide it as proof. I will also share my experience on other review platforms so that other patients can be aware of the service quality.
